Nominative case for the subject with a predicate nominative

cases.translation: so that the earth will know your paths
cases.explain: Nominative case for the subject of the verb 'познала' (knew)
Nominative case for the predicate nominative after the linking verb
Nominative case for the subject of the verb 'ликуют' (rejoice)
The preposition 'от' (from) requires the genitive case

cases.translation: the earth brings forth its harvest
cases.explain: The verb 'приносить' (to bring) takes the accusative case for the direct object

cases.translation: fear Him all the ends of the earth
cases.explain: Nominative case for the subject of the verb 'боялись' (feared)

reading.ru: Будь милостив к нам, Боже, и благослови нас, озари нас лицом своим
reading.question: What three things does the psalmist ask God to do?
options: Be merciful, bless, and let His face shine on them
reading.correct: Be merciful, bless, and let His face shine on them
reading.explain: The text asks God to 'будь милостив' (be merciful), 'благослови нас' (bless us), and 'озари нас лицом своим' (let Your face shine on us)

reading.ru: чтобы земля познала твои пути, все народы твое спасение
reading.question: What is the purpose of God's mercy and blessing?
options: So the earth will know His ways and all peoples His salvation
To defeat enemies and expand territory
reading.correct: So the earth will know His ways and all peoples His salvation
reading.explain: The text says the purpose is 'чтобы земля познала твои пути, все народы твое спасение' (so the earth will know Your ways, all peoples Your salvation)

reading.ru: Да прославят тебя народы Божия, да прославят тебя все народы
reading.question: What should the peoples do according to this verse?
reading.explain: The text repeatedly says 'да прославят тебя' (let them praise You)

reading.ru: потому что ты судишь народы по справедливости и управляешь племенами земли
reading.question: On what basis does God judge the peoples?
reading.explain: The text says 'судишь народы по справедливости' (judge peoples with justice)

reading.ru: Земля приносит свой урожай, да благословит нас Бог, наш Бог
reading.question: What does the earth produce, and what does God do?
options: The earth produces thorns; God destroys
The earth produces harvests; God blesses
The earth produces nothing; God punishes
The earth produces gold; God takes it away
reading.correct: The earth produces harvests; God blesses
reading.explain: The text says 'земля приносит свой урожай' (the earth brings its harvest) and 'да благословит нас Бог' (may God bless us)

reading.ru: Да благословит нас Бог, чтобы боялись Его все концы земли
reading.question: What is the hope expressed in this final blessing?
options: That God blesses them so all the earth may fear Him
That God gives them military victory
reading.correct: That God blesses them so all the earth may fear Him
reading.explain: The text expresses the hope 'да благословит нас Бог, чтобы боялись Его все концы земли' (may God bless us so that all the ends of the earth may fear Him)
